raw_meta_yaml:
context:
  name: roboplan
  version: "0.7.0"
  pinocchio_min: "4.1.0"
  pinocchio_max: "5.0.0"
  library_prefix: ${{ "Library/" if win else "" }}

recipe:
  name: roboplan
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/open-planning/roboplan/archive/refs/tags/${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: a1517f16fef9a8c676b95cf48b494e2d89e061c8fdd63d1e5abeaaba28d0504e

build:
  number: 1

# Two runs of upstream's superbuild/ tree feed every output below:
#   - roboplan-cpp: Python bindings off, split into the libroboplan-* outputs.
#   - roboplan-py:  Python bindings on (one per Python variant), split into
#     roboplan-common and the roboplan-*-python outputs, which take only the
#     site-packages files and depend on the libroboplan-* outputs at runtime.
# Each output keeps its own build/host/run requirements (inherit.run_exports=false),
# so run_exports and overlinking checks are scoped per package as before. The
# compiler and stdlib are repeated per compiled output so that their strong
# run_exports (libstdcxx, libgcc, __glibc) still land in each package's run deps.
outputs:
  - staging:
      name: roboplan-cpp
    build:
      script:
        file: build_metapackage
        env:
          ROBOPLAN_PYTHON_BINDINGS: "OFF"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - tinyxml2
        - yaml-cpp
        - proxsuite
        - libtoppra
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - qhull

  - staging:
      name: roboplan-py
    build:
      script:
        file: build_metapackage
        env:
          ROBOPLAN_PYTHON_BINDINGS: "ON"
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - cmake
        - ninja
        - python
        - nanobind
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - python
        - nanobind
        - nanobind-abi
        # Stub generation imports the roboplan.* packages, which import these.
        - numpy
        - pinocchio-python >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - tinyxml2
        - yaml-cpp
        - proxsuite
        - libtoppra
        - eigen-abi-devel
        - qhull
        - octomap

  # C++ libs

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-example-models
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_example_models/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_example_models/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}share/roboplan_example_models/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_example_models.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_example_models.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_example_models.*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-example-models", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_example_models

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-core
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_bindings/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/tinyxml2/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/tl/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan.dll
            - Library/bin/roboplan_filters.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan.lib
            - Library/lib/roboplan_filters.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan.*
            - lib/libroboplan_filters.*
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          # pinocchio's URDF parser pulls urdfdom into libroboplan's link.
          # urdfdom cannot be a host dep here: conda-forge pins it globally
          # to a version libpinocchio 4.1 does not build against, which would
          # make this output's solve diverge from the staging build.
          # libpinocchio's own urdfdom pin provides it.
          - "**/*urdfdom_world*"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-core", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - tinyxml2
        - yaml-cpp
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-oink
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_oink/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_oink/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_oink.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_oink.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_oink.*
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          # pinocchio's parallel algorithms pull the OpenMP runtime into the
          # link; libpinocchio's own _openmp_mutex dependency provides it.
          - "**/libgomp.so*"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-oink", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - proxsuite
        - qhull
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_oink

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-rrt
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_rrt/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/dynotree/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_rrt/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_rrt.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_rrt.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_rrt.*
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          # pinocchio's parallel algorithms pull the OpenMP runtime into the
          # link; libpinocchio's own _openmp_mutex dependency provides it.
          - "**/libgomp.so*"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-rrt", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - qhull
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_rrt

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-simple-ik
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_simple_ik/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_simple_ik/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_simple_ik.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_simple_ik.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_simple_ik.*
      dynamic_linking:
        missing_dso_allowlist:
          # pinocchio's parallel algorithms pull the OpenMP runtime into the
          # link; libpinocchio's own _openmp_mutex dependency provides it.
          - "**/libgomp.so*"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-simple-ik", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libcoal
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - qhull
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_simple_ik

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-toppra
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_toppra/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_toppra/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_toppra.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_toppra.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_toppra.*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-toppra", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libcoal
        - libtoppra
        - qhull
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_toppra

  - package:
      name: libroboplan-cartesian-planning
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-cpp
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - ${{ library_prefix }}include/roboplan_cartesian_planning/**
        - ${{ library_prefix }}lib/cmake/roboplan_cartesian_planning/**
        - if: win
          then:
            - Library/bin/roboplan_cartesian_planning.dll
            - Library/lib/roboplan_cartesian_planning.lib
          else:
            - lib/libroboplan_cartesian_planning.*
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("libroboplan-cartesian-planning", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - if: win
          then: dlfcn-win32
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-oink ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-toppra ==${{ version }}
        - qhull
        - eigen-abi-devel
    tests:
      - package_contents:
          lib:
            - roboplan_cartesian_planning

  - package:
      name: libroboplan
      version: ${{ version }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-example-models ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-oink ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-rrt ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-simple-ik ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-toppra ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-cartesian-planning ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - script:
          file: test_libs
        files:
          recipe:
            - test_libs.sh
            - test_libs.bat

  # Python libs

  - package:
      name: roboplan-common
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan_common/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-common", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      host:
        - python
      run:
        - python
    tests:
      # On win-64 the recorded casing of Lib/site-packages depends on which
      # host package created the directory first: scipy and pinocchio-python
      # record it as lowercase lib/, and whichever package wins the parallel
      # install decides the on-disk name for everything installed afterwards.
      # The path check below is case-sensitive, so it only runs where the
      # casing is deterministic. The import test covers Windows.
      - if: not win
        then:
          - package_contents:
              site_packages:
                - roboplan_common
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan_common

  - package:
      name: roboplan-example-models-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/example_models/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-example-models-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-example-models ==${{ version }}
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - numpy
        - pinocchio-python >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.example_models

  - package:
      name: roboplan-core-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/*.py"
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/core/**"
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/filters/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-core-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-core ==${{ version }}
        - libcoal
        - octomap
        - qhull
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - numpy
        - pinocchio-python >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.core
            - roboplan.filters

  - package:
      name: roboplan-oink-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/optimal_ik/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-oink-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-oink ==${{ version }}
        - qhull
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.optimal_ik

  - package:
      name: roboplan-rrt-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/rrt/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-rrt-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-rrt ==${{ version }}
        - libpinocchio >=${{ pinocchio_min }},<${{ pinocchio_max }}
        - qhull
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.rrt

  - package:
      name: roboplan-simple-ik-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/simple_ik/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-simple-ik-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-simple-ik ==${{ version }}
        - qhull
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.simple_ik

  - package:
      name: roboplan-toppra-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/toppra/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-toppra-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-toppra ==${{ version }}
        - qhull
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.toppra

  - package:
      name: roboplan-cartesian-planning-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    inherit:
      from: roboplan-py
      run_exports: false
    build:
      files:
        - "**/site-packages/roboplan/cartesian_planning/**"
    requirements:
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage("roboplan-cartesian-planning-python", upper_bound="x.x.x") }}
      build:
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
      host:
        - python
        - libroboplan-oink ==${{ version }}
        - libroboplan-cartesian-planning ==${{ version }}
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-oink-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-toppra-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - python:
          pip_check: false
          imports:
            - roboplan.cartesian_planning

  - package:
      name: roboplan-python
      version: ${{ version }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - python
        - roboplan-common ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-core-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-example-models-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-oink-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-rrt-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-simple-ik-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-toppra-python ==${{ version }}
        - roboplan-cartesian-planning-python ==${{ version }}
    tests:
      - script:
          file: test_libs
        files:

            - test_libs.bat
      - python:

            - roboplan.core
            - roboplan.example_models
            - roboplan.optimal_ik
            - roboplan.rrt

            - roboplan.toppra
